payload.title: docs/role.md still calls the purview guard re-entry-capped
payload.body: docs/role.md line ~228 describes the purview guard as fail-open, evidence-checked and re-entry-capped inherited from the sibling. After unit purview-guard-precise (commit 9e0e85ef) the guard has no cap: a refused call is judged again on every retry. The doc sits outside that unit's outputs, so it was left unchanged.
